name: GIST Internet
summary: Adelaide dialup/training ISP (Global-Link Internet Services & Training); in the SA peering community by Mar 1998; defunct.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of gist.net.au Apr 1997.

refs.label: Earliest capture 2 Apr 1997; footer copyright 1996 indicates the business traded from 1996. gist = Global-Link Internet Services & Training.
Last live (HTTP 200) capture of the ISP-era static homepage (1999 title: 'Global Link Internet Services & Training').
From May 2002 the homepage 302-redirected into a new ASP.NET site.
The replacement site (already live by 2002) is purely PC sales/repair - no internet access services; death window Sep 2001-May 2002.
